meta.purpose: Single Source of Truth for the maturity, wiring and health of every platform capability. This file is data, not prose — the Control Tower (and any dashboard, CI gate or status report) reads it. Humans read the generated CAPABILITIES.md.
meta.regenerateView: npm run render  (writes CAPABILITIES.md from this file)

plan.note: Agreed sequence — the system remembers its own roadmap, not just its state. Methodology: bring the coarse chain live first, observe real flow, only then add finer events.
steps: 1. Deploy the Control Plane (matriya-system) to production.
2. Set KNOWLEDGE_LEDGER_URL in matriya-back and maneger-back.
3. Let it run 2–3 days; watch real movements flow into the ledger.
4. THEN wire evidence.attached (intentionally deferred — too fine to debug before the ledger is live in prod).
5. Promote the JSONL ledger to a DB table for durable production storage.

philosophy.lens: Learning, not Knowledge. Knowledge is a picture; learning is a movie. The Control Room question shifts from 'how much knowledge is there?' to 'how does the lab learn?'
philosophy.lawIsLast: The law is the final product, not the starting point. Most AI systems start from the LLM; this one starts from biology: Reality → Events → History → Patterns → Models → Laws.
philosophy.ledgerIs: Episodic memory of the lab — a story ('Tuesday Rachel swapped a material; Thursday a measurement; Sunday a decision; a week later a customer complaint'), not a row ('Formula 27'). Immutable and append-only, so you can always walk back.
philosophy.invariant: Remove the LLM and the skeleton still stands: it keeps collecting, qualifying, recording and building history. The LLM is an accelerator at each stage, never the source of authority. Learning (the mechanism) is separated from inference (the LLM) so each layer can be tested, audited and improved on its own.

controlRoomModel.question: How does the lab learn?
controlRoomModel.note: The target Control Room metric is a learning funnel, not a count. Today only the top stage has a live source; each lower stage lights up as its capability is built — after real flow exists, per the roadmap.

status.ready: ✅ live and wired end-to-end (backend + frontend + API + DB)
status.partial: 🟡 exists but a layer or connection is missing / not wired in production
status.design: 🔵 designed on paper only — no implementation located
status.unknown: ⚪ asserted to exist but the codebase scan could not locate it

repositories.name: matriya-front
repositories.role: Research UI (Ask Matriya, upload, research, admin)

repositories.name: maneger-back
repositories.stack: Node + Express + Supabase + OpenAI + MS Graph + Resend

repositories.name: matriya-system
repositories.role: Platform Control Plane — home of this registry and the future Control Tower. (Was an abandoned RAG skeleton; the empty src/ tree is dormant and slated for removal once the Control Tower lands.)

connections.name: JWT auth
connections.notes: maneger-back proxies auth to matriya-back; same token bridges the two products.

connections.name: Supabase (Postgres)
connections.notes: Two separate instances by design — no shared DB; products integrate via API only.

connections.name: OpenAI
connections.notes: file_search + embeddings (maneger: text-embedding-ada-002). matriya-back also supports Together AI / HuggingFace.

connections.name: Microsoft Graph (SharePoint)
connections.notes: Code wired; needs Azure app registration (SHAREPOINT_*). Returns 400 if unconfigured.
connections.remedy: Register an Azure AD app and set SHAREPOINT_TENANT_ID / CLIENT_ID / CLIENT_SECRET.

connections.name: Email (Resend)
connections.notes: Inbound+outbound mail. NOTE: the product brief calls this 'Gmail' — actual implementation is Resend. Reconcile naming.
connections.remedy: Decide product naming (Gmail vs Resend); set RESEND_API_KEY + verified domain.

connections.name: Knowledge Ledger emit
connections.notes: Backends emit knowledge movements into the control-plane ledger (fire-and-forget, no-op unless configured). Code wired; not yet activated in deployments.
connections.remedy: Set KNOWLEDGE_LEDGER_URL in matriya-back and maneger-back to the control-plane URL.

capabilities.name: Authentication
capabilities.summary: JWT login/signup, single identity across both products.

capabilities.name: Project Management
capabilities.summary: Projects, tasks (FSM), milestones, notes, members, chat, audit log, RBAC.

capabilities.name: Laboratory
capabilities.summary: Experiments, runs, materials library, formulation parsing/comparison, lab AI insights.
openItems: Suggestion Engine is a UI placeholder with no backend logic.

capabilities.name: Document Intake
capabilities.summary: Upload + parse (PDF/DOCX/XLSX/CSV), chunking, storage (Supabase buckets), SharePoint pull.
openItems: Frontends rely on default/fallback API URLs — env vars not pinned in Vercel.

capabilities.name: RAG
capabilities.summary: Vector retrieval + grounded answers. matriya: local pgvector. maneger: management_vector + OpenAI file_search.

capabilities.name: Knowledge Engine
capabilities.summary: Kernel v1.6 breakdown detection, integrity monitor + rules engine, decision/research audit logs, evidence attribution.
openItems: No first-class 'Knowledge Event' entity yet — knowledge state is implied by audit/decision logs.
Admin/observability endpoints exist but UI coverage is partial.

capabilities.name: Knowledge Events
capabilities.summary: Append-only ledger of knowledge movements — the foundational substrate the whole learning pipeline stands on. Knowledge Growth is computed from it (the bank-statement model). Schema + ledger + live feed work in the control plane.
openItems: Emit points WIRED in code: document.ingested/removed (matriya-back + maneger-back), question.opened + intent.declared (maneger-back). Activate by setting KNOWLEDGE_LEDGER_URL in both backends.
evidence.attached emit point still to wire (matriya-back decision-audit flow).
Ledger shows seeded sample data until the backends are activated.
JSONL store is a POC — promote to a DB table for production.

capabilities.name: Change Detector
capabilities.summary: Senses + first nervous system: notice that something in reality differs from before, and filter signal from noise before it reaches the ledger. Today backends emit directly; this layer would qualify 'is this even a change?'.
openItems: Design only — emit points currently bypass any change-detection.

capabilities.name: Evidence Qualification
capabilities.summary: Immune system: is a change real, an error, or impossible? Qualify evidence before it is allowed to become accepted knowledge.
openItems: Design only — no qualification gate exists between an event and the ledger.

capabilities.name: Human Review
capabilities.summary: Cortex acceptance: a human accepts or rejects qualified evidence before it enters long-term memory and is allowed to change the model.
openItems: Design only — the 'accepted' funnel stage has no source yet.

capabilities.name: Episodic Linking
capabilities.summary: The hippocampus: connect events across time into chains/stories so patterns can emerge (material swap → cracks → supplier change → resolved). Asserts a link only after the whole chain exists — not before.
openItems: Design only — the ledger records movements but does not yet link them into episodes.
This is the organ that turns history into patterns.

capabilities.name: Learning Model
capabilities.summary: Produces learning, not knowledge — the model that changes as accepted evidence and linked episodes accumulate. 'Knowledge is a picture; learning is a movie.' This is the real subject of the Control Room's 'how does the lab learn?' question.
openItems: Design only — replaces 'how much knowledge?' with 'what changed the model, and why?'.

capabilities.name: Evolution Engine
capabilities.summary: Asserted to exist as a prototype, but the codebase scan did not locate an implementation.
openItems: ACTION: link the prototype source, or downgrade to 'design'. This is exactly the kind of ambiguity the registry exists to surface.

capabilities.name: Decision Engine
capabilities.summary: Turn learning into recommended engineering decisions (and, ultimately, laws). Design stage only — the last stage of the pipeline, not the first.

capabilities.name: Report Engine
capabilities.summary: matriya-back value-summary endpoints + maneger TXT project export. Not unified into one reporting capability.
openItems: Two ad-hoc exporters; no shared report model or unified output.

knowledgeGrowth.note: Computed live from the Knowledge Ledger (GET /api/knowledge) — the balance is a reduce over the event movements, never a stored datum. Values currently reflect SEEDED sample events until the product backends wire their emit points.
